query:
When Carol announced she would cook for Bev's visit, and Luis endorsed the value of home-cooked food at gatherings in the same session, the group settled around a norm about food at family events. Which family member's preferences are actually at odds with this norm, even though they said nothing to challenge it in the conversation?

Options:
A. Priya
B. Tyler
C. Bev
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Bev, episodic, t0 @2026-01-06T19:51:00) Carol your casserole is genuinely great but I'm taking you out to that new Italian place on fifth for your birthday. Non-negotiable. You've fed this family for forty years.
[2] (about=Carol, core, t14 @2026-02-24T19:16:00) Offered to have guest room ready and make chicken soup for Priya; suggested Bev come for dinner Saturday and Marcus/Dana are nearby.
[3] (about=Carol, core, t14 @2026-02-24T19:16:00) Brought casserole to game night; Dennis ate two portions which she considers a rave review.
[4] (about=Carol, said_by=Marcus, profile, t4 @2026-01-20T19:32:00) Mom, you'd actually enjoy a class. The social architecture of small groups is different from family. Less history.
[5] (about=Dana, core, t14 @2026-02-24T19:16:00) Offered to grab food with Priya on Saturday if she wants company without the whole family.
[6] (about=GROUP, said_by=Luis, group-interaction, t2 @2026-01-13T18:53:00) Proper celebration with grill in summer after baby arrives.
[7] (about=Marcus, episodic, t10 @2026-02-10T19:23:00) To be fair the grandchildren visit argument is actually one of the stronger predictors of whether extended family stays close across generations. I'm supportive. Also I want to flag something separately -- Dad, how's the knee been this week? You seemed to be favouring it on Saturday when Bev was over.
agent_answer: C. Bev — her stated preference was to take Carol out to the new Italian place rather than have Carol cook, which runs counter to the home-cooked-food norm, even though she didn’t argue against it in the session.

query:
When Rob and Priya announced they were visiting Columbus at the end of February, what did Carol decide about who would be at the visit — and which family member's explicit objection most directly overrode her plan?

Options:
A. Bev
B. Dennis
C. Dana
D. Rob
context:
[1] (about=Bev, episodic, t4 @2026-01-20T19:55:00) Carol, Dana is not closing the door. She's asking for a key. Those are different things. This is exactly why you need the watercolor class. Go meet some people who are not us.
[2] (about=Carol, core, t10 @2026-02-10T19:08:00) Would be thrilled with an October visit; will have guest room ready.
[3] (about=Carol, said_by=Rob, profile, t2 @2026-01-13T18:53:00) Carol ignores requests for quiet visits.
[4] (about=Carol, core, t10 @2026-02-10T19:08:00) Feels better knowing Dana and Marcus will be there; will send Jess the name of Dennis's old orthopedist.
[5] (about=Dana, episodic, t4 @2026-01-20T19:46:00) speaking of things. mom can we talk about the studio visit situation.
[6] (about=Dennis, core, t10 @2026-02-10T19:08:00) October works for a visit.
[7] (about=Dennis, said_by=Dana, profile, t10 @2026-02-10T19:08:00, [earlier-state]) Dana asks how long knee has been this bad; plans to come over Thursday to check in.
[8] (about=Dennis, said_by=Marcus, profile, t11 @2026-02-17T19:20:00, [earlier-state]) Dana and Marcus visited Thursday; Dennis agreed to call orthopedist on Friday.
[9] (about=Dennis, said_by=Dana, profile, t12 @2026-02-17T19:22:00) Dana and Marcus visited Thursday; Dennis agreed to call orthopedist on Friday. Dana told him if he didn't call she'd make the appointment herself. He called. Appointment is March 4th.
[10] (about=Jess, core, t10 @2026-02-10T19:08:00) Agrees with Luis about a second trip; kids were shy with Dennis on tablet call. Will look at October for a long weekend around Columbus Day.
[11] (about=Luis, core, t10 @2026-02-10T19:08:00) One Columbus trip a year isn't enough; kids need grandparents in the room, not just on a screen. Wants a second trip this year, possibly fall.
[12] (about=Marcus, episodic, t10 @2026-02-10T19:23:00) To be fair the grandchildren visit argument is actually one of the stronger predictors of whether extended family stays close across generations. I'm supportive. Also I want to flag something separately -- Dad, how's the knee been this week? You seemed to be favouring it on Saturday when Bev was over.
[13] (about=Priya, core, t2 @2026-01-13T18:53:00) Wants a quiet visit to Columbus, not a big gathering.
[14] (about=Rob, core, t14 @2026-02-24T19:16:00) Arriving around noon on February 28th; staying one night.
[15] (about=GROUP, said_by=Rob, group-interaction, t12 @2026-02-17T19:22:00) Rob and Priya will visit Columbus weekend of February 28th; no big gathering, just those already there.
[16] (about=GROUP, said_by=Carol, group-interaction, t2 @2026-01-13T18:53:00) Carol will plan a simple gathering with family (Bev, Marcus, Dana, Aunt Sheila) when Priya and Rob come to Columbus.
[17] (about=GROUP, said_by=Dana, group-interaction, t10 @2026-02-10T19:08:00) Dana and Marcus will visit Dennis on Thursday to check on his knee.
[18] (about=GROUP, said_by=Rob, group-interaction, t14 @2026-02-24T19:16:00) Rob and Priya will visit weekend of February 28th; just Rob and Priya on Saturday, Bev on Sunday.
[19] (about=GROUP, said_by=Luis, group-interaction, t10 @2026-02-10T19:08:00) Group agrees to plan a second Columbus trip in October, around Columbus Day, pending details.
[20] (about=GROUP, said_by=Carol, group-interaction, t8 @2026-02-03T19:12:00) Bev will come to Carol's house on Saturday to walk through for a valuation.
agent_answer:
Carol decided to plan a simple gathering with family: **Bev, Marcus, Dana, and Aunt Sheila**.

The explicit objection that most directly overrode that plan was **Priya’s** — she wanted a quiet visit, not a big gathering. Priya is not one of the listed options, so none of A–D is supported by the memory.
